docs.text: The scene is the single source of truth. A delegate pulls its changes on Sync (each delegate keeps its own ChangeCursor ) and uploads only what changed, so there is no separate render index. Every backend reads the scene with the same resolution rules ( resolve.h ) and writes the same render vars through the camera's sensor filters ( sensor_filters.h ). There are two ways to render: * headless and in simulation: StepAsync (or Step and Render ) renders the UsdRender products of a scene and returns their render vars; * interactively: Update then Record into the application's own command buffer each frame, submitted after SubmitWaits . Rendering is deterministic: an image's noise and samples derive from the camera's ernie:sensor:seed , its render product's path and its frame number ( NextFrame ), so the same scene renders the same images on any machine and whatever else renders alongside.

Detailed Description Small values ( Value : scalars, vectors, matrices, tokens, relationships) are set one at a time; bulk data ( Tensor : heights, points, instance transforms) is written as tensors, either to one prim or as rows of one tensor spread over many prims without copying. On a prim of a registered type ( prim_type.h ), setting and writing check the attribute against its declaration ( Validate ): a misspelt name or a value of the wrong type throws, while custom attributes in namespaces of their own are free. Every edit advances Version() and stamps the prim's dirty bit for that attribute ( DirtyOf ); transform and visibility edits stamp the prim's descendants too. Each consumer keeps a ChangeCursor and calls Changes to get every prim changed since its last call, so several consumers can follow one scene independently. Changes costs O(prims). Defining a prim defines its missing ancestors as typeless prims, as UsdStage::DefinePrim does. The root / always exists, untyped. docs.text: Small values ( Value : scalars, vectors, matrices, tokens, relationships) are set one at a time; bulk data ( Tensor : heights, points, instance transforms) is written as tensors, either to one prim or as rows of one tensor spread over many prims without copying. On a prim of a registered type ( prim_type.h ), setting and writing check the attribute against its declaration ( Validate ): a misspelt name or a value of the wrong type throws, while custom attributes in namespaces of their own are free. Every edit advances Version() and stamps the prim's dirty bit for that attribute ( DirtyOf ); transform and visibility edits stamp the prim's descendants too. Each consumer keeps a ChangeCursor and calls Changes to get every prim changed since its last call, so several consumers can follow one scene independently. Changes costs O(prims). Defining a prim defines its missing ancestors as typeless prims, as UsdStage::DefinePrim does. The root / always exists, untyped. References: * Pixar, "UsdStage", https://openusd.org/release/api/class_usd_stage.html * Pixar, "HdChangeTracker" (dirty bits), https://openusd.org/release/api/class_hd_change_tracker.html

docs.text: Struct ernie::SensorModel ClassList > ernie > SensorModel An image sensor: channels with quantum efficiency curves, full well, noise, gain and ADC. More... #include <ernie/scene/camera.h> Public Attributes Type Name int adcBits = 12 double blackLevelDn = 0.0 std::vector< SensorChannel > channels double darkCurrentElectrons = 0.1 Per second. double dsnuElectrons = 0.5 Standard deviation of the per-pixel offset. double electronsPerDnAtIso100 = 0.0 0 means full well over the ADC range. double fullWellElectrons = 20000.0 bool noise = true double prnu = 0.005 Standard deviation of the relative gain. double readNoiseElectrons = 3.0 Standard deviation. std::uint32_t seed = 0 Public Functions Type Name double ElectronsPerDn (double iso) const Electrons per digital number at iso . Public Static Functions Type Name SensorModel Mono () One panchromatic channel with a front-illuminated silicon response, like the monochrome pushbroom cameras of lunar orbiters. SensorModel Rgb () Bayer-like red, green and blue channels behind an infrared cut filter. Detailed Description Electrons accumulate as photons times quantum efficiency, plus dark current; the readout adds photon shot noise (Poisson), read noise (Gaussian), and per-pixel fixed patterns PRNU (relative gain) and DSNU (offset); electrons clip at the full well, and the ADC converts them to digital numbers with the ISO-dependent gain, adds the black level and clips to its bit depth. The presets are generic curve shapes, not any particular sensor: replace the channels with measured curves for a specific camera. Reference: EMVA Standard 1288, "Standard for Characterization of Image Sensors and Cameras", release 4.0, 2021 (the linear camera model). docs.text: Shapes and strides are in elements, as in DLPack; empty strides mean row-major contiguous. Copies share the memory and its owner. FromDlpack adopts a producer's tensor without copying and calls its deleter when the last Tensor referencing it is gone; ToDlpack hands memory to a consumer the same way. Reference: DLPack, https://dmlc.github.io/dlpack/latest/

docs.text: Class ernie::app::Demo ClassList > ernie > app > Demo A demo: a scene built in the constructor, advanced by Step , drawn by Render and checked by TestFinal , run by DemoRunner in a window, headless or without a viewer. More... #include <ernie/app/demo.h> Public Attributes Type Name std::string description Description , for demos to set. double fixedDt = 1.0 / 60.0 FixedDt , for demos to set. std::uint64_t frame = 0 Steps taken so far. double frameDt = 1.0 / 60.0 Seconds this step advances: in a window the time since the last frame (at most MaxFrameDt ), else FixedDt . double maxFrameDt = 1.0 / 30.0 MaxFrameDt , for demos to set. std::uint64_t numFrames = 100 NumFrames , for demos to set. double time = 0.0 Demo seconds at the start of this step. Public Functions Type Name virtual void Close () Releases what the demo holds beyond the scene and viewer, when it ends or the Demos panel replaces it; for timing reports and the like. Demo ( Viewer * viewer, const DemoOptions & options) viewer is null without one. Demo (const Demo &) = delete virtual std::string Description () const One line on what the demo shows, for the Demos panel and the log. virtual double FixedDt () const Seconds a step advances without a window, for runs that repeat: fixedDt . Renderer & GetRenderer () A renderer of the demo's own, opened on first use with the run's device, backend and validation: for rendering without a viewer, batches and tests. Scene & GetScene () The scene to build into: the viewer's, or the demo's own without a viewer. Viewer * GetViewer () The viewer, or null without one. const Tensor & Image () const The last frame rendered without a viewer ( Render ), LdrColor uint8 (rows, cols, 4); empty in a viewer. virtual double MaxFrameDt () const The longest step in a window, so a stall does not throw the demo: maxFrameDt . virtual std::uint64_t NumFrames () const Frames to run without a window when --num-frames is not given: numFrames . const DemoOptions & Options () const std::shared_ptr< Scene > OwnScene () The demo's own scene, shared, without a viewer (for holders that may outlive the demo, such as its Python wrapper); null with a viewer, whose owner holds the scene. virtual void Render () Draws a frame: the viewer's next, or without one the scene through GetRenderer into Image . Tensor RenderImage () The scene's LdrColor as its RenderSettings (or its first camera) describe, uint8 (rows, cols, 4): the last frame without a viewer, else rendered now with GetRenderer . virtual void SaveOutput (const std::filesystem::path & path) Writes --output : the viewport's next frame in a viewer, else the scene's LdrColor ( RenderImage ) as PNG. std::shared_ptr< Renderer > SharedRenderer () GetRenderer shared, for holders that may outlive the demo, such as its Python wrapper. virtual void Step () Advances the scene by frameDt seconds; nothing by default, for a still scene. virtual void TestFinal () Checks at the end of a --test run; throw to fail. virtual void TestPostStep () Checks after every step, under --test . bool Untested () const Whether a --test run found no checks: neither TestPostStep nor TestFinal is overridden. Demo & operator= (const Demo &) = delete virtual ~Demo () Detailed Description Ernie's own demos derive from it, in C++ and in Python ( ernie.demo.Demo ), as may any application's. The scene is the viewer's, or one of the demo's own without a viewer. Give it a camera of its own, even for a demo meant for the viewer (which frames the scene with its own camera): without a viewer, and in tests ( RenderImage ), the scene renders through it. In the viewer a demo uses it as any application does ( Viewer::AddPanel , OnFrame , SetActiveCamera ...); when the Demos panel switches away, what it added is removed (in the demo's scope, Viewer::SetScope ) and the viewport's display settings are restored. docs.text: Class ernie::app::Viewer ClassList > ernie > app > Viewer An interactive window onto an Ernie Scene : a docked viewport rendering the scene with a RenderDelegate (the rasterizer), plus Stage, Property, Render Settings, Sensor, Stats and Log panels. More... #include <ernie/app/viewer.h> Public Types Type Name enum Exposure How the viewport exposes its image: Auto keys the scene's metered average luminance to middle grey (adapting over a fraction of a second), Camera (the default) takes the camera's own exposure attributes as they are, and Default is automatic through the viewer's own camera and the camera's own through a scene camera. enum Gizmo What the transform gizmo on a single selected prim does: none, or translate, rotate or scale (the W, E and R keys), in world or local axes. Public Functions Type Name const Path & ActiveCamera () const The Camera prim the viewport looks through; PerspectiveCamera() until changed. std::uint64_t AddHudItem (std::string label, std::function< std::string( Viewer &)> value, bool shown=true) Adds a line to the viewport's heads-up display, "label: value" with the text value returns (asked a few times a second), such as a physics step's time; the eye menu's Heads Up Display submenu toggles it. void AddMenuItem (const std::string & menu, const std::string & label, std::function< void( Viewer &)> action) Adds label to the menu bar's menu (created if needed), running action when chosen. Panel & AddPanel (std::unique_ptr< Panel > panel) Adds a dockable panel, shown under Window in the menu bar. T & AddPanel (Args &&... args) Constructs a T (a Panel subclass) from args and adds it; returns it. Panel & AddPanel (std::string title, Dock dock, std::function< void( Viewer &)> draw) Adds a panel titled title that calls draw to draw its contents with Dear ImGui; for panels that need no class of their own. std::uint64_t AddViewportMenuItem (std::string label, std::function< void( Viewer &)> action, std::function< bool(const Viewer &)> checked={}) Adds label to the viewport's settings menu (its leftmost pill), running action when chosen; with checked , the item shows a check mark while it returns true. std::uint64_t AddViewportToggle (std::string label, bool shown=true, std::string overlay={}, std::function< void( Viewer &, bool)> changed={}) Adds a toggle to the viewport's eye menu, after the built-in ones, for what an application draws over the scene, such as physics contacts or labels. WidgetPanel & AddWidgetPanel (std::string title, Dock dock=Dock::Right) Adds a WidgetPanel titled title , for widgets added without ImGui (Python's panels). bool AutoExposing () const Whether the viewport currently exposes automatically ( Exposure ). const BrdfRegistry & Brdfs () const The reflectance models of the current backend, for material editors. Path CameraFromView (const Path & path) Defines a Camera prim at path in the scene with the active camera's transform and lens, and returns it. std::vector< Path > Cameras () const The cameras the viewport can look through: the viewer's own, then the scene's Camera prims by path. void Capture (const std::filesystem::path & path, std::string var={}) Writes the next viewport frame to path as PNG, showing var (the shown var when empty) as the viewport draws it, and on screen for that frame. void CaptureWindow (const std::filesystem::path & path) Writes the whole window as last drawn, UI and all, to path as PNG: for screenshot tests of the interface. void ClearAttribute (const Path & path, std::string_view attribute) Clears attribute of the prim at path , back to its fallback, as an undoable GUI edit. void ClearLog () void ClearScene () Empties the stage for new content: removes every prim but the viewer's own and every overlay but the viewer's (named with a leading "__"), clears the selection and undo history, and forgets the settings, camera and lighting the application chose. void Close () Asks the window to close; Run returns and Step returns false after the current frame. VulkanContext & Context () const VulkanContext & Context () const Path Create (std::string_view type) Creates a prim of type , any of the Create menu's ( CreatableTypes ), with defaults that make it show ( AuthorDefaultPrim ): under the selected Xform or Scope if one is, else its type's usual parent, at the view's target and scale. RenderDelegate & Delegate () The current backend itself, for what the viewer does not wrap, such as CUDA bindings. void Delete (std::span< const Path > paths) Deletes the prims at paths and their descendants as one undo step and clears the selection; the viewer's own prims are left alone. std::vector< Path > Duplicate (std::span< const Path > paths) Copies the prims at paths with their descendants and attributes (sharing tensors) beside themselves, named <name>_01 , <name>_02 ... with the first free number, as one undo step (Ctrl+D); selects and returns the copies. void Edit (const Path & path, std::string_view attribute, Value value, bool open=false) Sets attribute of the prim at path as a GUI edit, through the viewer's undo history ( History ). void EditLocalTransform (const Path & path, const glm::dmat4 & local, bool open=false) Gives the prim at path the local transform local as a GUI edit, as Edit does, through its own transform ops where they can represent it ( LocalTransformEdits ). double ExposureCompensation () const Stops of exposure compensation on top of either mode ( tokens::kExposureCompensation ). Panel * FindPanel (std::string_view title) The panel titled title , built-in ("Stats") or added; null if there is none. void FocusPanel (std::string_view title) Shows the panel titled title and brings it to the front: where it shares a dock with other panels its tab becomes the selected one, and it takes keyboard focus. void Frame (std::span< const Path > paths={}) Frames paths (the whole scene when empty) with the active camera (the F key). Exposure GetExposure () const FileDialog & GetFileDialog () The file dialog, open or not: for choosing through it from code, as tests do. Detailed Description The viewer keeps no scene state of its own: panels read the scene each frame and write edits back through Scene::Set , so edits from code and from the GUI are one history, seen by both. What only the GUI needs (its cameras, the viewport's render product, lighting presets) is defined under SessionRoot() , which panels hide unless asked to show it. The viewer defines its own perspective camera on opening, framing the scene ( PerspectiveCamera() , the default view). The viewport looks through it or any Camera prim of the scene; navigating moves whichever camera it looks through. Drive it in one of two ways, both on the thread that created it (GLFW needs the main thread on macOS): * Run() loops until the window closes; * Step() draws one frame and returns, for callers that own the loop, such as a simulation. Each frame runs, in order: OnFrame callbacks; the UI, whose panels may edit the scene, then OnUi callbacks; OnPreRender callbacks; the scene's sync and render, and presentation; OnPostRender callbacks. Callbacks run on the viewer's thread; an exception from one ends that frame and propagates out of Step or Run , and the viewer can step again afterwards. Applications extend it with panels ( AddPanel ), menu items ( AddMenuItem ) and callbacks; TerrainGen's viewer is one such application, adding its terrain configuration panels. docs.text: The viewer keeps no scene state of its own: panels read the scene each frame and write edits back through Scene::Set , so edits from code and from the GUI are one history, seen by both. What only the GUI needs (its cameras, the viewport's render product, lighting presets) is defined under SessionRoot() , which panels hide unless asked to show it. The viewer defines its own perspective camera on opening, framing the scene ( PerspectiveCamera() , the default view). The viewport looks through it or any Camera prim of the scene; navigating moves whichever camera it looks through. Drive it in one of two ways, both on the thread that created it (GLFW needs the main thread on macOS): * Run() loops until the window closes; * Step() draws one frame and returns, for callers that own the loop, such as a simulation. Each frame runs, in order: OnFrame callbacks; the UI, whose panels may edit the scene, then OnUi callbacks; OnPreRender callbacks; the scene's sync and render, and presentation; OnPostRender callbacks. Callbacks run on the viewer's thread; an exception from one ends that frame and propagates out of Step or Run , and the viewer can step again afterwards. Applications extend it with panels ( AddPanel ), menu items ( AddMenuItem ) and callbacks; TerrainGen's viewer is one such application, adding its terrain configuration panels.

Classes Type Name struct Frame One frame's zones. class ScopedZone Times the rest of the enclosing scope as a CPU zone named name while recording. struct Zone A timed span: a CPU zone of thread thread , or a GPU zone ( thread unused) on the device's own clock. Public Functions Type Name void AddGpuZone (std::uint64_t frame, const Zone & zone) Adds a GPU zone recorded during frame frame ; dropped if that frame is no longer kept. void BeginFrame () Ends the current frame and starts the next; the ended frame joins Frames (whether recording or not, so frame times show even before any zones). void Clear () std::uint64_t CurrentFrame () The index of the frame being recorded. bool Enabled () std::vector< Frame > Frames () The finished frames kept, oldest first, at most History of them. std::size_t History () std::uint64_t Now () Nanoseconds on the steady clock. void SetEnabled (bool enabled) Starts or stops recording; stopping keeps the frames recorded so far. void SetHistory (std::size_t frames) void SetThreadName (std::string name) std::uint32_t ThreadIndex () The calling thread's index in Zone::thread , and the names threads gave themselves ( SetThreadName , else "Thread <index>"), by index. std::vector< std::string > ThreadNames () Detailed Description Recording is off until SetEnabled ; while off a zone costs one atomic load. A frame runs from one BeginFrame to the next: CPU zones belong to the frame in which they end, GPU zones to the frame in which their commands were recorded (they arrive later, once the device has run them). The latest frames are kept, oldest first ( Frames ). Taudul, "Tracy Profiler", the Vulkan GPU zones (TracyVulkan.hpp). // https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy #include "ernie/device/vulkan_context.h" #include "ernie/util/profile.h" namespace ernie { class ScopedGpuZone { public: ScopedGpuZone(const VulkanContext& context, VkCommandBuffer commands, const char* name) : timer_(context.Timer()), commands_(commands), zone_(timer_.Begin(commands, name)) {} ~ScopedGpuZone() { timer_.End(commands_, zone_); } ScopedGpuZone(const ScopedGpuZone&) = delete; ScopedGpuZone& operator=(const ScopedGpuZone&) = delete; private: GpuTimer& timer_; VkCommandBuffer commands_; std::int64_t zone_; }; } // namespace ernie #define ERNIE_OWN_GPU_ZONE(context, commands, name) \ const ::ernie::ScopedGpuZone ERNIE_PROFILE_CONCAT(ernieOwnGpuZone, __LINE__)((context), \ (commands), name) #if ERNIE_TRACY // volk first: TracyVulkan.hpp calls Vulkan through volk's function pointers. #include <volk.h> #include <tracy/TracyVulkan.hpp> #define ERNIE_GPU_PROFILER(context) static_cast<tracy::VkCtx*>((context).GpuProfiler()) #define ERNIE_GPU_ZONE(context, commands, name) \ TracyVkNamedZone(ERNIE_GPU_PROFILER(context), TracyConcat(ernieGpuZone, TracyLine), commands, \ name, ERNIE_GPU_PROFILER(context) != nullptr); \ ERNIE_OWN_GPU_ZONE(context, commands, name) #else #define ERNIE_GPU_ZONE(context, commands, name) ERNIE_OWN_GPU_ZONE(context, commands, name) #endif

docs.text: Type Name class BoundableLight An area light (sphere, rect, disk): a radiant power, or a photometric power or illuminance. class DiskLight A disk in its xy plane emitting along -z. class DistantLight A light at infinity shining along the -z axis of its transform, such as the Sun. class DomeLight Light from every direction, optionally from a latitude-longitude map. class Light Any light: UsdLux's LightAPI inputs, its spectrum's shape and Ernie's physical spectrum. class NonboundableLight A light at infinity (distant, dome), whose photometric brightness is an illuminance. class RectLight A rectangle in its xy plane emitting along -z. class SphereLight A sphere (or point) light, optionally shaped to a cone around its -z axis.

The relationships ( camera , products , ernie:lights , orderedVars , ernie:filters ) are lists of targets; camera is one target, or on a product a batch of cameras. Not declared: a SensorFilter's inputs:* , which its filter type's model ( SensorFilterRegistry ) defines. References: * Pixar, UsdRender, https://openusd.org/release/api/usd_render_page_front.html * NVIDIA, "RTX - Minimal Mode", Omniverse Materials and Rendering documentation, https://docs.omniverse.nvidia.com/materials-and-rendering/latest/rtx-renderer_minimal.html

docs.text: File least_squares.h File List > ernie > util > least_squares.h Go to the documentation of this file // SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause #pragma once #include <array> #include <cmath> #include <cstddef> #include <utility> namespace ernie { template <std::size_t N> std::array<double, N> SolveNormal(std::array<std::array<double, N>, N> normal, std::array<double, N> right, std::size_t n) { std::array<double, N> scale{}; for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { scale[i] = normal[i][i] > 0.0 ? 1.0 / std::sqrt(normal[i][i]) : 0.0; } for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { for (std::size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) { normal[i][j] *= scale[i] * scale[j]; } right[i] *= scale[i]; } for (std::size_t c = 0; c < n; ++c) { std::size_t pivot = c; for (std::size_t r = c + 1; r < n; ++r) { if (std::abs(normal[r][c]) > std::abs(normal[pivot][c])) { pivot = r; } } if (std::abs(normal[pivot][c]) < 1e-300) { return {}; } std::swap(normal[c], normal[pivot]); std::swap(right[c], right[pivot]); for (std::size_t r = c + 1; r < n; ++r) { const double factor = normal[r][c] / normal[c][c]; for (std::size_t j = c; j < n; ++j) { normal[r][j] -= factor * normal[c][j]; } right[r] -= factor * right[c]; } } std::array<double, N> x{}; for (std::size_t c = n; c-- > 0;) { double sum = right[c]; for (std::size_t j = c + 1; j < n; ++j) { sum -= normal[c][j] * x[j]; } x[c] = sum / normal[c][c]; } for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { x[i] *= scale[i]; } return x; } template <std::size_t N> struct NormalEquations { std::array<std::array<double, N>, N> normal{}; std::array<double, N> right{}; void Add(const std::array<double, N>& row, double value, std::size_t n = N) { for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { for (std::size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) { normal[i][j] += row[i] * row[j]; } right[i] += row[i] * value; } } std::array<double, N> Solve(std::size_t n = N) const { return SolveNormal(normal, right, n); } }; } // namespace ernie

docs.text: Namespace List Here is a list of all namespaces with brief descriptions: namespace ernie Prim types as reflected schemas: each type declares its attributes once, as a list of (C++ type, name, USD token, fallback, metadata) entries, and that list gives both a typed view class over Scene ( GetRadius , HasRadius , SetRadius ) and the type's entry in a runtime registry ( PrimTypeDef ), which generic code walks: Python's typed prim classes, the viewer's property panels, loaders. namespace app namespace icons Lucide icon glyphs (lucide-static 1.52.0, private-use codepoints) as UTF-8 strings, for text drawn with the viewer's font, which has the icons merged in: ImGui::Button(icons::kSave) , or std::string(icons::kCamera) + " Camera" as a label. namespace detail What the view macros expand to. namespace profiler Ernie's in-process profiler: the zones of ERNIE_ZONE and ERNIE_GPU_ZONE ( ernie/util/profile.h , ernie/device/gpu_profile.h ) recorded frame by frame for a profiler panel, alongside Tracy's (which streams them to its own viewer in a profiling build). namespace render_vars Render var names, after Omniverse's where it has the quantity. namespace tokens Prim type and attribute names, following UsdGeom, UsdLux, UsdShade and UsdRender where those schemas have the concept, with Ernie's own under ernie: . namespace std

docs.text: Class Hierarchy This inheritance list is sorted roughly, but not completely, alphabetically: class ernie::AttributeDef One declared attribute of a prim type. class ernie::SchemaView Base of the typed views: a handle to one prim of a registered type, read-only when made from a const scene. class ernie::Imageable What every prim has: visibility and the world it is in. class ernie::Boundable What has local bounds: geometry and instancers, with an optional authored extent. class ernie::Gprim Geometry: drawn in a display colour, or with a bound material. class ernie::AxisShape An implicit shape centred on its origin along one of its axes: a cylinder, cone, capsule or plane. class ernie::Capsule A cylinder with hemispherical caps along its axis. class ernie::Cone A capped cone along its axis, its apex at +height / 2. class ernie::Cylinder A capped cylinder along its axis. class ernie::Plane A one-sided rectangle facing along its axis. class ernie::Cube A box centred on its origin, size along each axis. class ernie::PointBased Geometry from an array of points: a mesh or a point cloud. class ernie::Mesh A polygon mesh: points and the faces over them. class ernie::Points Points drawn as spheres widths across, coloured by their display colour. class ernie::Sphere A sphere centred on its origin. class ernie::Terrain A north-up heightfield (x east, y north, z up) drawn with its bound material, or, with a planet radius, a whole planet of six cube faces ( CubeSphereLod ). class ernie::Volume A volume (UsdVol); Ernie does not draw volumes yet. class ernie::PointInstancer Instances of its prototypes (the prototypes relationship's targets) at rows of positions, orientations and scales. class ernie::Camera A camera looking down its -z axis with +y up: UsdGeomCamera's projection, apertures, clipping, exposure and shutter, and Ernie's lens, scan, spectral sampling, sensor and view poses. class ernie::GroundPlane Ernie: an infinite horizontal floor facing +z at a world height, drawn with its material, optionally as a checkerboard. class ernie::Light Any light: UsdLux's LightAPI inputs, its spectrum's shape and Ernie's physical spectrum. class ernie::BoundableLight An area light (sphere, rect, disk): a radiant power, or a photometric power or illuminance. class ernie::DiskLight A disk in its xy plane emitting along -z. class ernie::RectLight A rectangle in its xy plane emitting along -z. class ernie::SphereLight A sphere (or point) light, optionally shaped to a cone around its -z axis. class ernie::NonboundableLight A light at infinity (distant, dome), whose photometric brightness is an illuminance. class ernie::DistantLight A light at infinity shining along the -z axis of its transform, such as the Sun. class ernie::DomeLight Light from every direction, optionally from a latitude-longitude map. class ernie::Material How a surface reflects light: Ernie's own inputs, or a UsdPreviewSurface its outputs:surface connects to. class ernie::RenderSettingsBase What render settings and products share (UsdRender's RenderSettingsBase ): the camera, the resolution, and what a product sets in place of its settings' (overlays, minimal shading). class ernie::RenderProduct One image a render writes: its camera (or a batch of cameras), resolution, render vars and sensor filter chain. class ernie::RenderSettings A render's settings: its camera, resolution and products, and the rasterizer's options. class ernie::RenderVar An output of a render product, named by its source, optionally with its own sensor chain. class ernie::Scope A grouping without a transform of its own. class ernie::SensorFilterPrim A SensorFilter prim (Ernie), one step of a sensor filter chain: a filter type and its inputs:* parameters. class ernie::Shader A node of a material's network, of the type info:id names, its inputs constants or connections ( <input>.connect ) to other shaders' outputs. class ernie::StarField Stars from a catalogue as points of light at infinity, behind everything else, each with a black-body spectrum. class ernie::Xform A transform grouping its children. class ernie::BrdfRegistry Reflectance models available to a renderer, keyed by BrdfModel::id . class ernie::FrameImages The images a backend renders one frame of a render product into, by render var name: what RenderVarOutput reads, whatever the backend. class ernie::ChunkedFrameImages The images of a frame of a batch of views that do not fit one set of images (such as more views than an image has layers): consecutive chunks of the views, each its own FrameImages . class ernie::ComputeInterop Zero-copy sharing between a Vulkan device and the compute device behind it (CUDA or HIP), so arrays from compute frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, CuPy, Warp, simulators) reach Ernie's buffers, and Ernie's results reach them, without passing through host memory. class ernie::CudaInterop ComputeInterop for the CUDA device behind a Vulkan device. class ernie::ComputePipeline A compute pipeline over a PipelineLayout . class ernie::CubeSphereLod CDLOD terrain over a whole planet: six LodQuadtree height pyramids, one per face of a cube projected onto a sphere of radius Radius() (a quadrilateralized or "cubed" sphere). class ernie::EditHistory Undo and redo for scene edits made through it: attribute sets and clears, prims defined, and prims removed with their descendants. class ernie::FrameUploads Host data bound for device buffers, staged for one frame in flight and copied by that frame's own commands ( Record ), so the host can prepare a frame while the device still runs earlier ones that read the same buffers: the copies wait on the device for that earlier work, in queue order, rather than the host waiting for it. class ernie::GpuBuffer A Vulkan buffer with its memory, allocated through VMA. class ernie::GpuImage A device-local Vulkan image with a view of all its mips and layers, allocated through VMA. class ernie::GpuTimer Times GPU zones ( ERNIE_GPU_ZONE ) for Ernie's profiler ( ernie/util/profiler.h ) with timestamp queries: a zone writes one timestamp where it starts and one where it ends in its command buffer, and Collect hands finished zones to the profiler without waiting for the device, then frees their queries by host reset (Vulkan 1.2's hostQueryReset). class ernie::GraphicsPipeline A graphics pipeline for dynamic rendering, with dynamic viewport and scissor and no culling. class ernie::IsdCameraModel What usgscsm's camera models of image support data share, in the body-fixed frame in metres: class ernie::IsdFrame A frame camera from its image support data, its geometry as usgscsm's frame model ( UsgsAstroFrameSensorModel ) computes it ( IsdCameraModel ): the whole image is exposed at once, at the ISD's centre time, from one position and orientation. class ernie::IsdLineScanner A line scanner (pushbroom camera) from its image support data, its geometry as usgscsm's line scanner model ( UsgsAstroLsSensorModel ) computes it ( IsdCameraModel ): line l is exposed around its time ImageTime(l) , a rate's start time plus its seconds per line times (l - its start line + 0.5), through detector line 0. class ernie::IsdPushFrame A push-frame camera (LROC's WAC, MRO's MARCI) from its image support data, its geometry as usgscsm's push-frame model ( UsgsAstroPushFrameSensorModel ) computes it ( IsdCameraModel ): the image is a stack of framelets, each a frame of FrameletLines lines exposed at once. class ernie::LodQuadtree Quadtree over a heightfield for continuous distance-dependent level of detail (CDLOD). class ernie::OffscreenTarget A colour and depth target for headless rendering, with readback of the colour image. class ernie::OrbitController Interactive orbit control of a CameraParams around a target point in a z-up world, for inspecting terrain. class ernie::Overlay A named layer of debug drawing: lines, shapes, markers and labels in world coordinates, drawn over the images of render products that ask for it ( tokens::kOverlays ), after the sensor filters, so they never reach observations that do not. class ernie::Path Absolute path naming a prim in a Scene , as in USD: / is the root and /World/Sun is the child Sun of /World . class ernie::PipelineLayout A pipeline layout with one push-descriptor set and an optional push-constant block shared by all stages. class ernie::Prim Handle to a prim in a Scene : its path plus the scene, for chained edits. class ernie::PrimSet A fixed list of prims to write rows of one tensor to at once ( Scene::Write ), such as a simulation's bodies every step: the scene looks the prims up the first time and keeps them, looking them up again only after prims are removed or for another scene. class ernie::RenderDelegate A render backend for a Scene , after Hydra's HdRenderDelegate: the rasterizer, and in future ray and path tracers, behind one interface that applications, the GUI viewer and the Python bindings drive without knowing which backend renders. class ernie::RenderVarOutput One render var of one rendered frame, such as LdrColor , named after UsdRender's RenderVar . class ernie::Renderer Ernie's front door for rendering a Scene headless: a GPU and a render backend on it, with no graphics API to set up. class ernie::Sampler An owned VkSampler . class ernie::Scene A lightweight, USD-shaped scene for Ernie: a tree of typed prims named by Path , each holding attributes by USD name, plus change tracking for render delegates. class ernie::ScopedGpuZone An ERNIE_GPU_ZONE for Ernie's profiler: timestamps around the rest of the scope's commands. class ernie::SensorFilterRegistry Custom sensor filters a renderer can run, by SensorFilterModel::id . class ernie::ShaderCompiler Compiles Slang modules at run time with the Slang compiler library, so shaders can be composed from built-in and user-supplied modules (such as custom reflectance models). class ernie::Spectrum A spectrum tabulated at increasing wavelengths and linearly interpolated between them; constant beyond the first and last samples. class ernie::StepOperation A submitted step: poll or wait for its GPU work, then fetch its outputs. class ernie::Swapchain A presentation swapchain for a window surface, with one "rendered" semaphore per image. class ernie::Targets Relationship targets given to a setter: one target (a Path or its text), stored as a single Path , or a list of them, stored as a list; reads take either. class ernie::Tensor A strided n-dimensional view of typed memory with an optional owner that keeps it alive: Ernie's end of DLPack. class ernie::Value A scene attribute value: one of the scalar, vector, matrix, token, relationship and small-array types Ernie's schemas use. class ernie::VulkanContext Owns a Vulkan instance, device, graphics and compute queue, and memory allocator. class ernie::app::Demo A demo: a scene built in the constructor, advanced by Step , drawn by Render and checked by TestFinal , run by DemoRunner in a window, headless or without a viewer. class ernie::app::DemoRunner Runs demos as Newton's examples run: opens the viewer the options ask for (or none), runs a demo until its window closes or it has run its frames, then writes --output , runs its final test and reports the benchmark. class ernie::app::FileDialog A modal file browser drawn with Dear ImGui, which Viewer shows for OpenFileDialog : a folder's contents with an Up button, an editable path and shortcuts to home, the working directory, the root and the folders used recently, a name field, a file type menu and Open (or Save) and Cancel. class ernie::app::Panel A dockable window of the viewer. class ernie::app::FunctionPanel A panel that draws its contents by calling a function. class ernie::app::WidgetPanel A panel of simple widgets described by data rather than ImGui calls, so code without ImGui bindings (Python) can build one. class ernie::app::Viewer An interactive window onto an Ernie Scene : a docked viewport rendering the scene with a RenderDelegate (the rasterizer), plus Stage, Property, Render Settings, Sensor, Stats and Log panels. class ernie::profiler::ScopedZone Times the rest of the enclosing scope as a CPU zone named name while recording. struct ernie::AttributeMeta How an attribute is described and edited. Declared with designated initializers in this order. struct ernie::AttributeTraits How the declared C++ type T reads, writes and converts: Read with the fallback (accepting any numeric or vector type an author used, as GetNumber does), Write , and From , a value as T or nullopt when it cannot be one. struct ernie::AttributeTraits< Path > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< Tensor > Bulk data: reads the written tensor or null (there is no fallback), writes with Scene::Write . struct ernie::AttributeTraits< bool > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< double > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< glm::dvec2 > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< glm::dvec3 > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< glm::dvec4 > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< int > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< std::string > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< std::vector< Path > > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< std::vector< float > > struct ernie::BrdfModel A reflectance model: shader source plus parameter metadata. struct ernie::BrdfParam One scalar parameter of a reflectance model, with what a UI needs to edit it. struct ernie::CahvoreModel A camera calibrated in JPL's CAHV family of models, as Mars rovers' cameras are (their PDS labels' GEOMETRIC_CAMERA_MODEL, JPL's camera model files): CAHV, a linear (pinhole) model; CAHVOR, with radial distortion about an optical axis; and CAHVORE, with a fish-eye term and an entrance pupil that moves along the optical axis with the field angle, so its rays do not meet at one point. struct ernie::CahvoreModel::ErnieCamera The model as Ernie renders it, in the model's frame (camera to frame). struct ernie::CahvoreModel::Ray A projection ray: its origin (C, or for CAHVORE the entrance pupil's position for its field angle) and unit direction. struct ernie::CameraParams A camera's parameters resolved from its Camera prim ( CameraParamsOf ): a physically based pinhole camera for one image, with UsdGeomCamera's pose, projection and exposure attributes, a spectral range, a lens and a sensor. struct ernie::CameraView The raster view of a camera for one frame, derived from a CameraParams by CameraParams::RasterView : what the rasterizer's passes need. struct ernie::Change A prim's changes since a consumer last looked. struct ernie::ChangeCursor A consumer's position in a scene's history; see Scene::Changes . struct ernie::ComputeArrayView A Vulkan image seen by a compute API in place, as an opaque array handle (a CUarray for CUDA, a hipArray_t for HIP): read it with that API's texture or surface objects or 2D array copies. struct ernie::Connection The source of a UsdShade connection: a Shader prim and one of its outputs, e.g. "outputs:rgb". struct ernie::CubeSphereRegion Region of space holding one node of a CubeSphereLod : every direction within angle of axis , between radii inner and outer from the body's centre. struct ernie::DescriptorBinding One binding of a pipeline's push-descriptor set (set 0). struct ernie::DescriptorResource What a binding points at when descriptors are pushed. struct ernie::DetailSettings Tiling of the detail albedo and normal textures. struct ernie::Device struct ernie::DomeDirection One of a dome map's regions of about equal energy ( DomeDirectionsOf ), in the map's frame. struct ernie::DomeParams An environment light at infinity (UsdLux DomeLight ) resolved for a frame ( DomeParamsOf ): radiance from every direction, the spectrum radiance (W m^-2 sr^-1 nm^-1 per camera band) times a relative RGB map whose cosine-convolved spherical harmonics are sh . struct ernie::DomeSun A sun found in a dome's map ( ExtractDomeSun ), in the map's frame. struct ernie::DomeSunExtraction The sun of a latitude-longitude dome map ( tokens::kLightTexture layout) and the map without it, for lighting the sun as a shadowed distant light while the dome keeps the rest of the sky. struct ernie::FrameId Where an image sits in the deterministic random streams of sampling.h . struct ernie::FrameImages::LinearVar A render var the frame holds as one linear buffer over every view rather than an image: written by the frame's own submission, in memory a compute API views in place ( BufferMemory::Shared ), texels of format view after view. struct ernie::FrameParams Per-frame parameters of a render, whatever the backend: the camera, the sun, the other lights, the sensor filters and the frame's place in the random streams. struct ernie::FrameParams::SensorChain Several sensor chains over the one raster image, each writing its own vars (render vars with their own ernie:filters ); empty runs filters for vars . struct ernie::Frustum Six world-space clip planes of a view-projection matrix, for culling axis-aligned boxes. struct ernie::GpuXform A prim posed on the GPU: its transform ops are rows of GPU arrays, one row per prim of one Scene::Write of many paths, so a renderer composes its local transform per instance from the arrays whole, as a PointInstancer 's: translate, then orient, then scale. struct ernie::GraphicsPipelineDesc Fixed-function state of a graphics pipeline that draws triangle lists without vertex buffers. struct ernie::IesProfile A luminaire's photometric profile from an IES LM-63 file (type C photometry): its luminous intensity in candela over the vertical angle theta from its nadir (0, straight down its axis) to its zenith (180 degrees) and the horizontal angle phi around the axis. struct ernie::Image RGBA image with linear float channels, rows top to bottom. struct ernie::ImageDesc Description of a 2D image or 2D image array. struct ernie::InstanceData Per-instance arrays of a point instancer, as UsdGeomPointInstancer defines them. struct ernie::IsdCameraModel::FrameView A frame of the detector as Ernie renders it: a frame camera of the image's samples by its rows, posed ( camera.transform , camera to body-fixed world) when the frame is exposed, the lens's distortion fitted as Brown-Conrady terms (and scale). struct ernie::IsdLineScanner::Strip A strip of lines image lines from firstLine as Ernie renders it: a pushbroom camera ( CameraParams::pushbroom ) whose rows are those lines, posed from at the strip's first line's start and to at its end (camera to body-fixed world). struct ernie::IsdPushFrame::Framelet Framelet __ framelet (in image order, from the top) as Ernie renders it: a frame camera of the image's samples by FrameletLines lines, posed when it is exposed (camera to body-fixed world), its exposure the ISD's, the lens's distortion fitted as Brown-Conrady terms (and scale). struct ernie::IsdRotation A rotation sampled over time between two NAIF frames, as ALE reads it ( ale::Orientations ): quaternions (w, x, y, z, scalar first) of the time-dependent rotation of vectors from the reference frame into the first of timeDependentFrames , and a constant rotation (row-major, applied to vectors after it) on into the first of constantFrames . struct ernie::IsdSamples States sampled over time: ephemeris times (seconds past J2000, TDB) and a value at each. struct ernie::IsdSensor A camera's image support data (ISD) in the Community Sensor Model's JSON form, as ALE (the USGS Abstraction Layer for Ephemerides) writes it from SPICE kernels for planetary cameras such as LRO's NAC and WAC, MRO's CTX and HiRISE: the image's size and timing, the focal plane's map to detector pixels, the optics, and the spacecraft's and the body's states over the image. struct ernie::LensModel A lens: its projection, natural vignetting and transmission. struct ernie::LensRayTable A lens given as its rays: unit directions in the camera's frame at every step th sensor pixel corner, ( width / step + 1) by ( height / step + 1) of them row by row from the top left, interpolated between. struct ernie::LightParams A light besides the sun, resolved for a frame from its prim ( LightParamsOf ). struct ernie::LodPatch One square patch of PatchCells() x PatchCells() grid quads whose vertices are 2^level raster cells apart. struct ernie::LodRange Distances from the LOD eye, in world units, over which one level's vertices morph towards the next coarser level's. struct ernie::LrocWacBandSpec One WAC band's published values. struct ernie::MappedRenderVar A mapped render var: a tensor for Cpu and Gpu , a compute array for GpuArray . struct ernie::Mars2020Hazcam The Hazcams' optics (Maki et al. struct ernie::Mars2020Navcam The Mars 2020 rover Perseverance's Navcam pair (Maki et al. 2020, Table 2). struct ernie::MastcamZ struct ernie::MastcamZ::Filter A filter's Table 3 effective wavelength and half width at half maximum, nm (for filter 0, the green Bayer channel's), and its neutral density (filter 7's; 0 otherwise). struct ernie::MaterialSettings How a surface reflects light: a material's settings. struct ernie::MeshData Triangle mesh geometry in a mesh's own frame. struct ernie::NamedCahvore A named camera model in a frame, as camera model files list them. struct ernie::NormalEquations Accumulates the normal equations of a linear least-squares fit, row by row. struct ernie::OverlayItem What every overlay item carries besides its geometry. struct ernie::OverlaySegment A line segment of width pixels. struct ernie::OverlaySprite A rectangle facing the image at a fixed size in pixels, placed by a world point: rect spans (x0, y0) to (x1, y1) pixels from where anchor projects, y down. struct ernie::OverlayStyle How overlay items look. struct ernie::OverlayTriangle A filled triangle. struct ernie::PrimTypeDef A registered prim type: its name ( Scene::Define 's type), its base, and the attributes it declares itself; abstract ones, such as "Light", are bases only. struct ernie::ProductFrame A rendered frame of a render product: its render targets and how to reach them. struct ernie::PushbroomStrip A pushbroom camera's strip for one frame ( CameraParams::pushbroom ), as its shaders project with it (projection_pushbroom.slang): its rows' poses run from from (the top row's camera position) to to (the bottom row's), turning from fromRotation to toRotation along the great arc. struct ernie::RasterView Non-owning view of a north-up grid of float samples with square cells: the form in which Ernie takes heightfields and albedo maps. struct ernie::RenderPrims The prims a render of scene uses, as every render delegate resolves them: struct ernie::RenderProductOutput The outputs of one render product in a step: its render vars by name. struct ernie::RenderProductSpec A render product to draw, resolved from UsdRender prims. struct ernie::RenderStats What a delegate holds, for statistics panels. struct ernie::RendererInfo What a render backend is and does, so applications, settings panels and bindings can adapt. struct ernie::RendererOptions Options for creating a Renderer . struct ernie::RenderingTarget Attachments of one dynamic-rendering pass. struct ernie::SamplerDesc Sampler filtering and addressing. struct ernie::SensorChannel One channel of a sensor: its quantum efficiency (electrons per photon) over wavelength. struct ernie::SensorFilterModel A sensor filter written in Slang, run in the fused sensor kernel like the built-in ones: a struct typeName in module slang implementing IBandFilter (kind Band , domain Spectrum ), IPixelFilter (kind Pixel , on one of the other domains), or for kind Spatial , which reads the pixels around its own, ISpatialBandFilter (domain Spectrum ) or ISpatialPixelFilter (the other domains). struct ernie::SensorFilterOutput One output of a sensor filter. struct ernie::SensorFilterParam A custom filter's parameter: a float its prim sets as inputs:<name> , or with size above 1 an array of floats ( float name[size] in the filter's Params , such as a curve; sensor.slang's curveAt reads one), which the prim sets as a float array of any length, resampled linearly to size (a single number fills it). struct ernie::SensorFilterStep One filter of a product's chain: a SensorFilter prim's ernie:filter:type , a built-in's name or a registered filter's id, with the floats of its inputs:* attributes by name (without "inputs:"). struct ernie::SensorModel An image sensor: channels with quantum efficiency curves, full well, noise, gain and ADC. struct ernie::ShaderModuleSource One Slang module given as source text. Other modules import it by name . struct ernie::ShadowSettings Cascaded shadow map options. struct ernie::SigmoidSpectrum A smooth reflectance spectrum in Jakob and Hanika's sigmoid-polynomial form: s(lambda) = 1/2 + x / (2 sqrt(1 + x^2)) with x = c0 t^2 + c1 t + c2 and t the wavelength mapped from 360-830 nm to 0-1. struct ernie::SpectralBands A wavelength range split into count bands of equal width, the spectral sampling of one camera. struct ernie::Star One star of a StarField , as renders take it: where it is and the black-body spectrum it shines with. struct ernie::StarCatalogue A star catalogue as a StarField 's arrays take it: right ascension and declination in degrees, visual magnitude and B-V colour index per star. struct ernie::StarFieldParams The stars of a StarField prim ( StarsOf ) are uploaded when they change; each frame takes only where the catalogue's frame lies ( StarFieldParamsOf ). struct ernie::Swapchain::Frame One acquired image, ready to render into after waiting on acquired ; signal rendered when done and pass the frame to Present . struct ernie::TextureReader A texture read through mesh texture coordinates: a UsdUVTexture with the primvar reader and UsdTransform2d feeding it, which is also glTF's textureInfo with KHR_texture_transform and MaterialX's image, texcoord and place2d nodes. struct ernie::TimelinePoint A wait for or a signal of a timeline semaphore value in a submission. struct ernie::TriangleCorners Where each corner of TriangulateFaces ' triangles comes from: its face and its position in faceVertexIndices , for primvars with uniform and faceVarying interpolation. struct ernie::VulkanContextOptions Options for VulkanContext::Create . struct ernie::XformOps A prim's local transform as translate, rotate (Euler angles or a quaternion) and scale, the ops of USD's UsdGeomXformCommonAPI. struct ernie::app::CreatableType A prim type the viewer's Create menu makes, with its menu label and group, the name new prims take, and the prim they go under unless a group prim is selected. struct ernie::app::CreateContext Where a new prim goes and what it starts from. struct ernie::app::DemoInfo A demo the runner can build, for the Demos panel and DemoMain . struct ernie::app::DemoOptions The options every demo takes ( ParseDemoOptions ), as Newton's examples share theirs. struct ernie::app::DirectoryEntry One row of a folder listing. struct ernie::app::DockSizes The default layout's docks as fractions of the window: what each takes of the space left once the docks before it are placed (left, then the right column, then the bottom). struct ernie::app::FileDialogOptions What a file dialog asks for ( Viewer::OpenFileDialog ). struct ernie::app::FileFilter A choice of the file dialog's file type menu: a label and the extensions it shows, such as {"Terrain configurations", {".json"}}; no extensions shows every file. struct ernie::app::FrameInfo Per-frame information passed to OnFrame , OnPreRender and OnPostRender callbacks. struct ernie::app::LogEntry One message of the viewer's log ( Viewer::Log ). struct ernie::app::PropertyField One known attribute a panel edits: how to show it, and what Ernie uses when it is not authored. struct ernie::app::PropertySection A titled group of fields, such as a prim type's "Light" or "Shape" attributes. struct ernie::app::Theme Colours (sRGB-encoded with alpha, as written to the screen) and metrics of the viewer's UI. struct ernie::app::ViewerOptions Options for opening a Viewer . struct ernie::app::ViewportDisplay What the viewport draws over the scene, as Kit's viewport "show by type" menu (the eye) and heads-up display settings choose. struct ernie::profiler::Frame One frame's zones. struct ernie::profiler::Zone A timed span: a CPU zone of thread thread , or a GPU zone ( thread unused) on the device's own clock. struct ernie::EditHistory::PrimSnapshot One prim of a removed subtree, enough to define it again. struct ernie::EditHistory::Step struct ernie::FrameUploads::Copy struct ernie::FrameUploads::Staging struct ernie::GpuTimer::Pending struct ernie::Scene::PrimData struct ernie::Scene::UniqueId A process-wide unique id that copies and assignments renew. struct std::hash< ernie::Path >

docs.text: This inheritance list is sorted roughly, but not completely, alphabetically: class ernie::AttributeDef One declared attribute of a prim type. class ernie::SchemaView Base of the typed views: a handle to one prim of a registered type, read-only when made from a const scene. class ernie::Imageable What every prim has: visibility and the world it is in. class ernie::Boundable What has local bounds: geometry and instancers, with an optional authored extent. class ernie::Gprim Geometry: drawn in a display colour, or with a bound material. class ernie::AxisShape An implicit shape centred on its origin along one of its axes: a cylinder, cone, capsule or plane. class ernie::Capsule A cylinder with hemispherical caps along its axis. class ernie::Cone A capped cone along its axis, its apex at +height / 2. class ernie::Cylinder A capped cylinder along its axis. class ernie::Plane A one-sided rectangle facing along its axis. class ernie::Cube A box centred on its origin, size along each axis. class ernie::PointBased Geometry from an array of points: a mesh or a point cloud. class ernie::Mesh A polygon mesh: points and the faces over them. class ernie::Points Points drawn as spheres widths across, coloured by their display colour. class ernie::Sphere A sphere centred on its origin. class ernie::Terrain A north-up heightfield (x east, y north, z up) drawn with its bound material, or, with a planet radius, a whole planet of six cube faces ( CubeSphereLod ). class ernie::Volume A volume (UsdVol); Ernie does not draw volumes yet. class ernie::PointInstancer Instances of its prototypes (the prototypes relationship's targets) at rows of positions, orientations and scales. class ernie::Camera A camera looking down its -z axis with +y up: UsdGeomCamera's projection, apertures, clipping, exposure and shutter, and Ernie's lens, scan, spectral sampling, sensor and view poses. class ernie::GroundPlane Ernie: an infinite horizontal floor facing +z at a world height, drawn with its material, optionally as a checkerboard. class ernie::Light Any light: UsdLux's LightAPI inputs, its spectrum's shape and Ernie's physical spectrum. class ernie::BoundableLight An area light (sphere, rect, disk): a radiant power, or a photometric power or illuminance. class ernie::DiskLight A disk in its xy plane emitting along -z. class ernie::RectLight A rectangle in its xy plane emitting along -z. class ernie::SphereLight A sphere (or point) light, optionally shaped to a cone around its -z axis. class ernie::NonboundableLight A light at infinity (distant, dome), whose photometric brightness is an illuminance. class ernie::DistantLight A light at infinity shining along the -z axis of its transform, such as the Sun. class ernie::DomeLight Light from every direction, optionally from a latitude-longitude map. class ernie::Material How a surface reflects light: Ernie's own inputs, or a UsdPreviewSurface its outputs:surface connects to. class ernie::RenderSettingsBase What render settings and products share (UsdRender's RenderSettingsBase ): the camera, the resolution, and what a product sets in place of its settings' (overlays, minimal shading). class ernie::RenderProduct One image a render writes: its camera (or a batch of cameras), resolution, render vars and sensor filter chain. class ernie::RenderSettings A render's settings: its camera, resolution and products, and the rasterizer's options. class ernie::RenderVar An output of a render product, named by its source, optionally with its own sensor chain. class ernie::Scope A grouping without a transform of its own. class ernie::SensorFilterPrim A SensorFilter prim (Ernie), one step of a sensor filter chain: a filter type and its inputs:* parameters. class ernie::Shader A node of a material's network, of the type info:id names, its inputs constants or connections ( <input>.connect ) to other shaders' outputs. class ernie::StarField Stars from a catalogue as points of light at infinity, behind everything else, each with a black-body spectrum. class ernie::Xform A transform grouping its children. class ernie::BrdfRegistry Reflectance models available to a renderer, keyed by BrdfModel::id . class ernie::FrameImages The images a backend renders one frame of a render product into, by render var name: what RenderVarOutput reads, whatever the backend. class ernie::ChunkedFrameImages The images of a frame of a batch of views that do not fit one set of images (such as more views than an image has layers): consecutive chunks of the views, each its own FrameImages . class ernie::ComputeInterop Zero-copy sharing between a Vulkan device and the compute device behind it (CUDA or HIP), so arrays from compute frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, CuPy, Warp, simulators) reach Ernie's buffers, and Ernie's results reach them, without passing through host memory. class ernie::CudaInterop ComputeInterop for the CUDA device behind a Vulkan device. class ernie::ComputePipeline A compute pipeline over a PipelineLayout . class ernie::CubeSphereLod CDLOD terrain over a whole planet: six LodQuadtree height pyramids, one per face of a cube projected onto a sphere of radius Radius() (a quadrilateralized or "cubed" sphere). class ernie::EditHistory Undo and redo for scene edits made through it: attribute sets and clears, prims defined, and prims removed with their descendants. class ernie::FrameUploads Host data bound for device buffers, staged for one frame in flight and copied by that frame's own commands ( Record ), so the host can prepare a frame while the device still runs earlier ones that read the same buffers: the copies wait on the device for that earlier work, in queue order, rather than the host waiting for it. class ernie::GpuBuffer A Vulkan buffer with its memory, allocated through VMA. class ernie::GpuImage A device-local Vulkan image with a view of all its mips and layers, allocated through VMA. class ernie::GpuTimer Times GPU zones ( ERNIE_GPU_ZONE ) for Ernie's profiler ( ernie/util/profiler.h ) with timestamp queries: a zone writes one timestamp where it starts and one where it ends in its command buffer, and Collect hands finished zones to the profiler without waiting for the device, then frees their queries by host reset (Vulkan 1.2's hostQueryReset). class ernie::GraphicsPipeline A graphics pipeline for dynamic rendering, with dynamic viewport and scissor and no culling. class ernie::IsdCameraModel What usgscsm's camera models of image support data share, in the body-fixed frame in metres: class ernie::IsdFrame A frame camera from its image support data, its geometry as usgscsm's frame model ( UsgsAstroFrameSensorModel ) computes it ( IsdCameraModel ): the whole image is exposed at once, at the ISD's centre time, from one position and orientation. class ernie::IsdLineScanner A line scanner (pushbroom camera) from its image support data, its geometry as usgscsm's line scanner model ( UsgsAstroLsSensorModel ) computes it ( IsdCameraModel ): line l is exposed around its time ImageTime(l) , a rate's start time plus its seconds per line times (l - its start line + 0.5), through detector line 0. class ernie::IsdPushFrame A push-frame camera (LROC's WAC, MRO's MARCI) from its image support data, its geometry as usgscsm's push-frame model ( UsgsAstroPushFrameSensorModel ) computes it ( IsdCameraModel ): the image is a stack of framelets, each a frame of FrameletLines lines exposed at once. class ernie::LodQuadtree Quadtree over a heightfield for continuous distance-dependent level of detail (CDLOD). class ernie::OffscreenTarget A colour and depth target for headless rendering, with readback of the colour image. class ernie::OrbitController Interactive orbit control of a CameraParams around a target point in a z-up world, for inspecting terrain. class ernie::Overlay A named layer of debug drawing: lines, shapes, markers and labels in world coordinates, drawn over the images of render products that ask for it ( tokens::kOverlays ), after the sensor filters, so they never reach observations that do not. class ernie::Path Absolute path naming a prim in a Scene , as in USD: / is the root and /World/Sun is the child Sun of /World . class ernie::PipelineLayout A pipeline layout with one push-descriptor set and an optional push-constant block shared by all stages. class ernie::Prim Handle to a prim in a Scene : its path plus the scene, for chained edits. class ernie::PrimSet A fixed list of prims to write rows of one tensor to at once ( Scene::Write ), such as a simulation's bodies every step: the scene looks the prims up the first time and keeps them, looking them up again only after prims are removed or for another scene. class ernie::RenderDelegate A render backend for a Scene , after Hydra's HdRenderDelegate: the rasterizer, and in future ray and path tracers, behind one interface that applications, the GUI viewer and the Python bindings drive without knowing which backend renders. class ernie::RenderVarOutput One render var of one rendered frame, such as LdrColor , named after UsdRender's RenderVar . class ernie::Renderer Ernie's front door for rendering a Scene headless: a GPU and a render backend on it, with no graphics API to set up. class ernie::Sampler An owned VkSampler . class ernie::Scene A lightweight, USD-shaped scene for Ernie: a tree of typed prims named by Path , each holding attributes by USD name, plus change tracking for render delegates. class ernie::ScopedGpuZone An ERNIE_GPU_ZONE for Ernie's profiler: timestamps around the rest of the scope's commands. class ernie::SensorFilterRegistry Custom sensor filters a renderer can run, by SensorFilterModel::id . class ernie::ShaderCompiler Compiles Slang modules at run time with the Slang compiler library, so shaders can be composed from built-in and user-supplied modules (such as custom reflectance models). class ernie::Spectrum A spectrum tabulated at increasing wavelengths and linearly interpolated between them; constant beyond the first and last samples. class ernie::StepOperation A submitted step: poll or wait for its GPU work, then fetch its outputs. class ernie::Swapchain A presentation swapchain for a window surface, with one "rendered" semaphore per image. class ernie::Targets Relationship targets given to a setter: one target (a Path or its text), stored as a single Path , or a list of them, stored as a list; reads take either. class ernie::Tensor A strided n-dimensional view of typed memory with an optional owner that keeps it alive: Ernie's end of DLPack. class ernie::Value A scene attribute value: one of the scalar, vector, matrix, token, relationship and small-array types Ernie's schemas use. class ernie::VulkanContext Owns a Vulkan instance, device, graphics and compute queue, and memory allocator. class ernie::app::Demo A demo: a scene built in the constructor, advanced by Step , drawn by Render and checked by TestFinal , run by DemoRunner in a window, headless or without a viewer. class ernie::app::DemoRunner Runs demos as Newton's examples run: opens the viewer the options ask for (or none), runs a demo until its window closes or it has run its frames, then writes --output , runs its final test and reports the benchmark. class ernie::app::FileDialog A modal file browser drawn with Dear ImGui, which Viewer shows for OpenFileDialog : a folder's contents with an Up button, an editable path and shortcuts to home, the working directory, the root and the folders used recently, a name field, a file type menu and Open (or Save) and Cancel. class ernie::app::Panel A dockable window of the viewer. class ernie::app::FunctionPanel A panel that draws its contents by calling a function. class ernie::app::WidgetPanel A panel of simple widgets described by data rather than ImGui calls, so code without ImGui bindings (Python) can build one. class ernie::app::Viewer An interactive window onto an Ernie Scene : a docked viewport rendering the scene with a RenderDelegate (the rasterizer), plus Stage, Property, Render Settings, Sensor, Stats and Log panels. class ernie::profiler::ScopedZone Times the rest of the enclosing scope as a CPU zone named name while recording. struct ernie::AttributeMeta How an attribute is described and edited. Declared with designated initializers in this order. struct ernie::AttributeTraits How the declared C++ type T reads, writes and converts: Read with the fallback (accepting any numeric or vector type an author used, as GetNumber does), Write , and From , a value as T or nullopt when it cannot be one. struct ernie::AttributeTraits< Path > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< Tensor > Bulk data: reads the written tensor or null (there is no fallback), writes with Scene::Write . struct ernie::AttributeTraits< bool > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< double > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< glm::dvec2 > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< glm::dvec3 > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< glm::dvec4 > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< int > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< std::string > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< std::vector< Path > > struct ernie::AttributeTraits< std::vector< float > > struct ernie::BrdfModel A reflectance model: shader source plus parameter metadata. struct ernie::BrdfParam One scalar parameter of a reflectance model, with what a UI needs to edit it. struct ernie::CahvoreModel A camera calibrated in JPL's CAHV family of models, as Mars rovers' cameras are (their PDS labels' GEOMETRIC_CAMERA_MODEL, JPL's camera model files): CAHV, a linear (pinhole) model; CAHVOR, with radial distortion about an optical axis; and CAHVORE, with a fish-eye term and an entrance pupil that moves along the optical axis with the field angle, so its rays do not meet at one point. struct ernie::CahvoreModel::ErnieCamera The model as Ernie renders it, in the model's frame (camera to frame). struct ernie::CahvoreModel::Ray A projection ray: its origin (C, or for CAHVORE the entrance pupil's position for its field angle) and unit direction. struct ernie::CameraParams A camera's parameters resolved from its Camera prim ( CameraParamsOf ): a physically based pinhole camera for one image, with UsdGeomCamera's pose, projection and exposure attributes, a spectral range, a lens and a sensor. struct ernie::CameraView The raster view of a camera for one frame, derived from a CameraParams by CameraParams::RasterView : what the rasterizer's passes need. struct ernie::Change A prim's changes
